name: PiFrame h264ify
description: Forces video sites to serve H.264 / VP9 instead of AV1 by lying about MediaSource.isTypeSupported. Pi 5 has no AV1 hardware decode and libdav1d on the CPU caps real-world 1080p60 playback. Loaded only in webview mode (kiosk renderer's content is from the NAS / not AV1).
